parties: In re Spears; and In re Danser.

opinions.text:
Motions of petitioners for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied, and petitions for writs of habeas corpus dismissed. See this Court’s Rule 39.8.
Justice Kagan took no part in the consideration or decision of these motions and these petitions.
